note: Genesis Molecular AI (Genesis Therapeutics), AI-driven small-molecule discovery; a 2023 listing with no milestone. Early-stage entry, uncited.

Getaround, peer-to-peer car sharing; Menlo partnered at the Series A in 2011 (firm's own page). NYSE-listed by SPAC in 2022 (GETR), delisted in 2025, and the US business ceased operations in February 2026 — defunct rather than acquired.
Gild, data-driven technical recruiting; Citadel acquired its team and technology in 2016. Form D 2014 $13.5M with Venky Ganesan.

Gilead Sciences (GILD, Nasdaq), biopharmaceuticals; IPO 1992. Menlo backed it in 1988 with DuBose Montgomery on the board — the firm's oldest famous position and squarely pre-window, so entry_stage is null by policy. A public $1B+ row: the cited market cap is owed by the A/B pass.
Glympse, real-time location sharing; acquired in 2022. Form D 2011-2016 with Pravin Vazirani; a seed entry whose follow-ons did not clear the graduation test.
Good Job Games, mobile game studio; Menlo partnered at the seed in 2024 (firm's own page). Istanbul-founded.

Goodfire, AI interpretability; MENLO ENTERED AT THE $7M SEED of Aug 2024 (Lightspeed led), not the $50M Series A it led in Apr 2025 — the firm's own Milestones say Seed 2024 and the seed's press release lists Menlo. The Form D band read Growth off the 2025-2026 filings.
Graphite, AI developer-productivity and code review; Menlo partnered at the Series B in 2025 (firm's own page). Cursor (Anysphere) acquired it in 2026.
Grow Therapy, insurance-covered mental health care; Menlo partnered at the Series D in 2025 (firm's own page).
GTronix, analog/mixed-signal sensor ICs; National Semiconductor acquired it in 2010. First listed 2005, pre-window, entry_stage null by policy — the band's 'Seed' rides a 2009 filing.

H1, healthcare data platform; in the firm's own words 'In April 2020, Menlo led the Series A in H1 Insights'. The Form D band read Growth off the 2020-2024 filings to $121M; the December-2020 co-led Series B is the follow-on.
Handle, task and email management; wound down in 2015. Form D 2012-2013 $2.5M with Shawn Carolan.

Harness, software delivery platform; Menlo partnered at the Series A in 2017 (firm's own page). Last primary $3.7B (2022); the deterministic layer carries an older $1.7B mark, queued for the A/B pass.

Heap, digital insights and product analytics; Menlo partnered at the Series A in 2016 (firm's own page). Contentsquare acquired it in 2023. The Form D band read Growth off the 2021 $112.6M filing, five years after the entry.
Heidi Health, ambient AI medical scribe; Menlo partnered at the Series A in 2024 (firm's own page). Australian company.

Higgsfield, generative video for social content; Menlo partnered at the seed in 2024 (firm's own page). The $5.4B mark is the deterministic layer's; it goes to the A/B pass for a priced-event citation.

HNC Software, neural-network fraud analytics (Falcon); NASDAQ IPO 1995, Fair Isaac acquired it in 2002 for $810M. A late-1980s Menlo position on the 1998 software page, pre-window, entry_stage null by policy.

Hotmail; Microsoft acquired it in 1997 for ~$400M. The firm's own Milestones mark 1996 as the partnering year but state no round ('Partnered'), and the entry is pre-window in any case, so entry_stage is null by policy. Doug Carlisle is the attributed partner.
Hover, 3D property models from smartphone photos; Menlo partnered at the Series C in 2019 (firm's own page).
iBasis, international VoIP wholesale; NASDAQ IPO 1999, KPN took control in 2007 and Tofane Global bought it in 2018. A late-1990s Menlo position, pre-window, entry_stage null by policy.
Immersive Labs, cyber workforce resilience; Menlo partnered at the Series C in 2021 (firm's own page). British company.

IMVU, avatar-based social; restructured under Together Labs and its assets were sold on in 2024. First listed 2006, so the entry is on the window edge and no round is stated; left null rather than guessed.

Indio Technologies, insurance application software; Applied Systems acquired it in 2020. Menlo partnered at the Series B in 2019 (firm's own page); the Form D band read Series A off the same year's $22M filing.

Information Advantage, OLAP and business intelligence; NASDAQ IPO 1997, Sterling Software acquired it in 1999. A 1990s Menlo position on the 1998 software page, pre-window, entry_stage null by policy.
Infoseek, one of the first web search engines; NASDAQ IPO 1996, Disney took control in 1998 and folded it into Go.com. A 1994-95 Menlo position, pre-window, entry_stage null by policy.
IntelliDOT, bedside barcode medication administration; acquired in 2011. First listed 2004, pre-window, entry_stage null by policy — the band's 'Growth' rides a 2009 $2.0M filing.
Interlink Computer Sciences, TCP/IP for IBM mainframes; NASDAQ IPO 1996, Sterling Commerce acquired it in 1999. A 1990s Menlo position, pre-window, entry_stage null by policy.

INVIDI Technologies, addressable television advertising; acquired in 2020 by a consortium of AT&T, Dish and WPP. Form D 2010 $23.2M with Hal Calhoun. First listed 2004, so the band's stage rides a filing six years after the entry — recorded at low confidence.

IronPort Systems, email and web security; Cisco acquired it in 2007 for $830M. Menlo partnered at the Series B in 2002 (firm's own page). The 'defunct' pre-fill is wrong: an acquisition retires the row as acquired (COLLECTION.md 6).
Jobfox, career matching; wound down around 2011. Form D 2009 $3.0M with Sonja Perkins.
JuliaHub, the Julia language company for modelling and simulation; Menlo partnered at the Series A in 2021 (firm's own page).
JUMP Bikes, dockless e-bikes; Menlo partnered at the Series A in 2017 (firm's own page). Uber acquired it in 2018 for ~$200M and passed it to Lime in 2020.
Kalpana, the inventor of Ethernet switching; Cisco acquired it in 1994 for $240M — Cisco's first acquisition. A 1990-92 Menlo position, pre-window, entry_stage null by policy.

Kazeon Systems, ediscovery and information governance; EMC acquired it in 2009. First listed 2007, so the entry is pre-window on the site dating and the band's 'Series A' rides the 2009 filing; left null.

Kinetic (Kinetic Automation), automated calibration service centres for ADAS and EVs; Menlo partnered at the Series B in 2024 (firm's own page). The public/$50.2M pre-fill is a namesake collision with a listed company of the same name — disputed. The base also carries 'kinetic-automation', the same company under its legal name.
Kinetic Automation is the legal name of the company the site lists as 'Kinetic'; Form D 2024 $21.0M with Shawn Carolan. Duplicate of 'kinetic', canonical there.
Knoetic, people analytics for CHROs; Menlo partnered at the Series B in 2022 (firm's own page).
Koala Health, pet pharmacy; Menlo partnered at the Series A in 2022 (firm's own page), Form D 2022 $20.0M with Greg Yap.
Legora, collaborative AI for lawyers; Menlo partnered at the Series D in 2026 (firm's own page). Swedish company; last primary $1.8B (2025 Series C).
Levelpath, AI-first procurement; Menlo partnered at the Series A in 2023 (firm's own page).
Librato, metrics and monitoring; SolarWinds acquired it in 2015. Form D 2010 $2.8M with John Jarve.
Like.com, visual product search; Google acquired it in 2010 for ~$100M. First listed 2009 with no milestone and no Menlo filing; entry round not established.
Lindy, AI assistant and agent builder; Menlo partnered at the seed in 2020 (firm's own page).
Livingly Media, lifestyle digital publishing; acquired by Evolve Media in 2018. A REST-only listing with no milestone; entry round not established.

Lovable, natural-language app building; Menlo partnered at the Series B in 2025 (firm's own page and its own announcement post) and doubled down in the 2026 $400M Series C. Swedish company — the Wikidata pre-fill said IT.
